name: Pattaya

routes.outcome: Official Department of Lands cadastral-map center page. It advertises LandsMaps and other cadastral-map services; homepage HTML exposed local path https://www.dol.go.th/landmap/services.

Official Pattaya City GIS report. Its land-parcel section defines parcel geometry and states that private parcel geometry is published by the Department of Lands; it describes Parcel ID as a basic locating identifier. The report is documentation, not a live query endpoint.

Thai government open-data catalogue entry for Department of Lands parcel geometry by title-deed number. It states that API use requires an application/permission and Consumer-Key/Consumer-Secret; no credentials were requested or used.
Attempted anonymous HTTPS GET with TLS verification enabled; connection timed out. This is not evidence of parcel absence or a map-extent miss.
Attempted anonymous HTTPS GET with TLS verification enabled; connection failed before an HTTP response. This is not evidence of parcel absence.
Public ArcGIS service metadata returned HTTP 200. It exposes a national Land Development Department service with layer 0 named land-parcel location and layer 1 land-use polygons.

Layer metadata returned HTTP 200. Layer 0 is esriGeometryPoint, native CRS Web Mercator wkid 3857, and fields include OBJECTID and PARCEL_ID. It is not a full parcel-polygon layer, so it was not retained as cadastral polygon evidence; USERCREATE/DATECREATE/USERUPDATED/DATEUPDATED were not requested in a feature query.

Attempted bounded anonymous exact WUP-point query with WGS84 point [100.899623454323,12.9298716398823], intersects, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, resultRecordCount=3, outFields=OBJECTID. Service returned HTTP 400 Bad Request; no feature count, identity, or geometry was inferred.

localCustodianAssessment: Pattaya City is evidenced as a local GIS custodian through its official GIS report, which documents a land-parcel layer. The Department of Lands is the national cadastral custodian and its official map center/LandsMaps is the relevant public service. The LDD ArcGIS endpoint is a general national land-information service, not evidence of a Pattaya local registry endpoint.
